title: Single-Sample Decoding of a Two-Layer Sound-Word Canvas Model for Thai Klon Pad
abstract: arXiv:2610.14980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a generator of Thai klon pad verse, one stanza from a short topic, and evaluate it against human verse on held-out topics. The generator is a masked language model initialised from WangchanBERTa over a fixed canvas with two layers: a sound layer of pronounced syllables, where rhyme, tone and syllable count are enforced as hard masks, and a word layer of whole words, so that no word is cut into written pieces. Decoding commits one cell at a time and samples at temperature 0.4; one sample is drawn per topic, with no selection, reranking or repair. On 78 held-out topics never used in development, judged by three independent runs of a frozen LLM judge in the same pools as the human stanzas from which the topics were written, 70.5% of the generated stanzas pass form, lexical cleanness of all four lines and topic alignment together, against 76.9% for the human stanzas (difference -6.4 points, 95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]). translated_title: 面向泰语克隆八诗的双层音-词画布模型的单样本解码
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个泰语克隆八诗生成器，它能够从简短的主题生成一个诗节，并在保留主题上将其与人类诗作进行对比评估。该生成器是一个掩码语言模型，由WangchanBERTa初始化，构建在一个具有两层的固定画布之上：音层由发音音节组成，其中韵律、声调和音节数作为硬掩码被强制执行；词层由完整词汇组成，从而确保没有任何词被切分成书面碎片。解码过程每次提交一个单元格，并以0.4的温度进行采样；每个主题只抽取一个样本，不进行任何选择、重排序或修复。在78个开发过程中从未使用过的保留主题上，由冻结的大语言模型裁判在与人类诗节相同的池中进行三次独立运行评判，70.5%的生成诗节同时通过了格律、全部四行的词汇洁净度以及主题一致性检验，而人类诗节的通过率为76.9%（差异为-6.4个百分点，95%置信区间[-19.2, +6.4]）。洁净度水平……
tldr: 该研究提出一个基于双层音-词画布的掩码语言模型泰语克隆八诗生成器，每个主题仅采样一次且无需任何筛选或修复，其生成诗节在格律、词汇洁净与主题一致上的综合通过率达70.5%，已接近人类诗节的76.9%。
en_tdlr: A two-layer sound-word canvas masked language model for Thai klon pad verse, decoded with a single sample and no selection or repair, achieves a 70.5% joint pass rate on form, lexical cleanness and topic alignment, close to the 76.9% of human stanzas.
